<think>**Optimizing one-hot decode**

{
  "candidate_rtl": "module mux_large (
    input [7:0] block_a, block_b, block_c, block_d, block_e,
    input [7:0] block_f, block_g, block_h, block_i, block_j,
    input [3:0] sel,
    output reg [7:0] block_out
);
    wire lo0, lo1, lo2, lo3;
    wire bank0, bank1, bank2;
    wire en_a, en_b, en_c, en_d, en_e;
    wire en_f, en_g, en_h, en_i, en_j;

    assign lo0 = ~sel[1] & ~sel[0];
    assign lo1 = ~sel[1] &  sel[0];
    assign lo2 =  sel[1] & ~sel[0];
    assign lo3 =  sel[1] &  sel[0];

    assign bank0 = ~sel[3] & ~sel[2];
    assign bank1 = ~sel[3] &  sel[2];
    assign bank2 =  sel[3] & ~sel[2];

    assign en_a = (bank0 & lo0) | (sel[3] & (sel[2] | sel[1]));
    assign en_b = bank0 & lo1;
    assign en_c = bank0 & lo2;
    assign en_d = bank0 & lo3;
    assign en_e = bank1 & lo0;
    assign en_f = bank1 & lo1;
    assign en_g = bank1 & lo2;
    assign en_h = bank1 & lo3;
    assign en_i = bank2 & lo0;
    assign en_j = bank2 & lo1;

    always @(*) begin
        block_out = ({8{en_a}} & block_a)
                  | ({8{en_b}} & block_b)
                  | ({8{en_c}} & block_c)
                  | ({8{en_d}} & block_d)
                  | ({8{en_e}} & block_e)
                  | ({8{en_f}} & block_f)
                  | ({8{en_g}} & block_g)
                  | ({8{en_h}} & block_h)
                  | ({8{en_i}} & block_i)
                  | ({8{en_j}} & block_j);
    end
endmodule
",
